QuestInfo.name: Dimension Master
QuestInfo.0: Anyone who participate in the Dimension Invasion will receive special rewards.
QuestInfo.1: Piston told you about a Medal for successfully defending Pantheon 100 times in Dimension Invasion.
QuestInfo.2: You received the Dimension Defender Medal.

0.0: The invasion of our home continues. I have another Medal for you, if you're willing. Pantheon will forever remember you.

no.0: No? Okay, that's it for you then.
